task: Estimate the proportion of registered generators with any liquid class, any solid class, and both states, in a public historical registration inventory.
data: Ontario Hazardous Waste Public Information: 2002-2022 Generator Registration and Waste Classes
privacy_unit: One literal generator registration number, aggregated before fitting. Not a company, individual manifest, year, or transport event.
roster: Fixed, already public benchmark registration roster; participation is not protected.
calibration: Already public, SHA-256 registration partition modulo 5 equal to 0; release partition consists of the other registrations.
calibration_target: registered_class_count: count of distinct waste class codes, a public complexity proxy; never released
replicates: Thirty predeclared seeds per strategy and budget; all failures and replicates retained. These are alternative public-data research runs, not an authorized confidential multi-release campaign.
primary_analysis: Standard GRR marginal frequency decoding, without clipping; also report raw randomized-response proportions.
secondary_analysis: Both-state coverage estimated by multiplying the two independent binary GRR inverse weights within each released row; negative or >1 estimates remain recorded.
baseline: Data-free public-domain midpoint 0.5 for each binary marginal; diagnostic reference, not an external competing algorithm.
primary_acceptance: For the uniform configuration at total epsilon=2, the observed 90th percentile across 30 runs of the maximum marginal absolute error is <=2 percentage points. This is an author-selected research tolerance, not an operational standard or a confidence interval.
secondary_acceptance: For the uniform configuration at total epsilon=2, the observed 90th percentile of the both-state absolute error is <=5 percentage points.
intervals: 95% simultaneous Hoeffding marginal intervals over the two binary yes proportions, calculated only from public released counts, n, and field epsilons. No ground truth used in their construction.
selection: Uniform is designated as the main configuration before evaluation. Heuristic is a prespecified comparator, not selected after observing release errors. No release-driven tuning of domains, priors, alpha, epsilon, seeds, or population.
limits: No claims about waste mass, current registrations, independent user adoption, optimal allocation, full industrial microdata utility, numerical mechanism accuracy, or physical repair. Public data do not constitute a confidential deployment.
